comment: Classes were essentially just discussion of the assigned readings. She's great at facilitating class discussions and is very careful to ensure that everyone gets a chance to share their thoughts. She puts on a tough act, but it's clear how much she cares about her students and their academic journeys.

I absolutely loved this class. Dr. Loo has extremely high expectations and her classes are heavy on discussion and require you do the readings. I would not suggest taking Dr. Loo if you are looking to skate by with a history class because you will have to put in actual work to do well and must do the readings to participate in class.

Dr. Loo's class is discussion-based, so make sure to read every material assigned and prepare to participate frequently in class. Though history is pretty challenging for me, I never feel bored in Dr. Loo's class because she guides us to think about the issues from different perspectives. Her feedback for the papers is thought-provoking.

Loo is amazing. Acts very tough with very high expectations, but an incredibly kind person when you get to know her. Incredibly smart and you learn so much from talking to her. Participate, even when it's intimidating- she stretches students to think in entirely new ways and really improve themselves as scholars and people.

Dr. Loo is one the best professors at Richmond. When you first walk into her class she comes across very tough and requires you to print out all the readings. However, she teaches incredibly and I learned a lot of information that I won't forget. She is a very reasonable grader and it's not hard to do well on papers/ exams. Definitely take her.

Puts on a tough face on the first day to weed out the weak but don't be scared. Easily one of my most interesting classes at UR. I took her Tokyo trials for gen ed and was so intrigued the whole time. She genuinely cares about each student. Be prepared to do the reading and participate, otherwise, you'll be completely lost. Made me a better student
Make sure you do the reading. If you do the reading you will be fine in the class.

Dr. Loo is terrifying at first like scared to slouch terrifying. If you don't have your book you have to go get it and she'll call you out for not participating. But her class is one of the most rewarding classes I have ever taken. She wants you to learn and grow and has taught me so much. I wont take her again, but everyone should once. Take her!!

I took her Collecting the Past Class. It's a good class to get back into the swing of discussions. It is really easy to participate in her class and she is a great discussion leader. You usually have one 3-20 page reading to annotate before every class. There are two 5 page papers and a final 10 page paper, pretty easy if you take notes.

There is no doubt that Dr. Loo is one of the best professors at UR. She does look a bit like a terrifying and tough grader when you first meet her but she is not like that at all. Her class can be challenging so get ready to be pushed out of your comfort zone. Also, she really cares about her students. A true humanities professor.
Dr. Loo is a scary prof but amazing human being. She really gets you to think at the higher level. Be prepared to discuss. Can be a harsh grader, but its for your own benefit

I took her for collecting the past fys, definitely one of the most interesting classes I've ever taken but you have to do the reading and you have to participate. She is a really good teacher and I was lowkey excited to go to class
SHE is good at teaching but have clear preferences

Loo is kind of terrifying at first, but when it comes down to it, she really wants her students to succeed. She wants to make you think and learn in ways you've never had to. I learned so much in her class and am really going to miss it next semester. She is always willing to help, especially when you show interest in the material. Take her!!!

One of the smartest people I've ever met and knows it. Wont tolerate BS. Forget your reading materials and you'll be asked to leave until you return with them. Wont scrutinize papers if you write coherently. Cares about students and is accessible outside class. If you're serious about learning, take her classes. You won't regret it.

Dr. Loo is the most phenomenal professor I have had.  She holds her students to the highest standards of excellence, however, her demands do not come without reward.  She instilled in me an intrinsic sense of curiosity about the world around me and an insatiable desire for knowledge and learning. Reading the text and class participation are key!

Demands participation. You've probably heard that a lot about many professors, but Loo takes it to another level, and you better make sure it's worthy of her ears or else she will put you down in front of the class. A great professor but an incredibly rude and pompous person. Would love to learn more about eastern civilization, but not under her.

I've taken her three times for a reason. Truly one of the best teachers I've ever had --- class time is enjoyable but meaningful. Dr. Loo demands a lot of critical thinking from her students and is not super easily satisfied, but it's worth it.
The class is really fun, if you read and participate. You enter the class, ten minutes pass, and the class is over.

Prof. Loo is honestly one of, if not the, best professor at Richmond. She is incredibly interesting and makes the class fun and engaging. She grades pretty harshly, but definitely doesn't tank you. Take her and stick with it. You won't regret it.
SHE IS THE GREATEST! DONT LOOK BACK, JUST TAKE HER

Hard grader but a good teacher. She expects a lot from you and God help you if you don't do the reading. Has a great sense of humor and is easily embarrassed, which can make for some fun times. The class I took was required and I wasn't interested in the subject, but she did a good job keeping things engaging. I learned a lot and don't regret it.

SHE IS THE GREATEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD! TAKE ANY CLASS WITH DR. LOO AND YOU WILL NOT BE DISAPPOINTED! She honestly is the best teacher I have ever had in my life and she has taught me so much that I can never thank her enough for. The class is hard, but it is completely worth it for what you learn. She has really changed my life.
Easily the best teacher I've had here.  Made the books something completely different than what I'd thought they were while reading.  Extremely rough grader but it's worth it I suppose.
No Comments
